title: Protest at Jantar Mantar Ends After 36 Days
summary: The protest at Jantar Mantar ended after 36 days. The government claimed that the protesters had withdrawn, citing a victory in their demands. Police said they had maintained law and order during the protests. The opposition alleged that the government had used force to disperse the crowd. The protesters announced a win in their demands for better infrastructure at the site.
summary_points: The protest at Jantar Mantar lasted for 36 days.
The government claimed that the protesters had withdrawn, citing a victory in their demands.
Police said they had maintained law and order during the protests.
The opposition alleged that the government had used force to disperse the crowd.
The protesters announced a win in their demands for better infrastructure at the site.
title_hi: जंतर मंतर आंदोलन खत्म , छात्रों ने जीत का किया एलान
summary_hi: जंतर मंतर आंदोलन खत्म हो गया, सरकार ने दावा किया कि विरोधकों ने अपने मांगों पर जीत हासिल की है। पुलिस ने कहा कि उन्होंने विरोध के दौरान कानून और व्यवस्था बनाए रखी। विपक्ष ने सरकार को बल का उपयोग करने का आरोप लगाया। विरोधकों ने साइट पर बेहतर संरचना की मांग पर जीत घोषित की।
summary_points_hi: जंतर मंतर आंदोलन 36 दिनों तक चला.
